description: Gate: block irrecoverable Bash patterns (rm -rf, push --force, --no-verify, reset --hard, clean -f)

Gate: ask the human to approve edits to BOTH non-model verifiers — hooks/gates/** + hooks/advisory/** + hooks/hooks.json (deny-gates + advisory sensors + wiring) AND skills/harness-audit/scripts/audit.sh + checks/** (audit grader). Tamper-resistance: the model cannot edit the code that judges it. Emits permissionDecision: ask (no env-var bypass). Also folds the former path-hardcode deny (blocks hardcoded /Users/<name> in .sh/.py/.js) since 2026-07-03; one fewer python3 spawn per Write/Edit. NotebookEdit added 2026-08-06.
Gate: ask the human to approve Bash-mediated writes (redirect, tee, sed -i, cp, mv) to verifier surfaces — closes the Write/Edit matcher's blind spot. Emits permissionDecision: ask.
Gate: ask on non-SELECT execute_sql-shaped MCP calls, on any server. No-op when no such MCP server is configured (matcher never fires).

Gate: a subagent may not mark its own task completed (maker≠checker). Only the main session completes tasks; validator subagents return verdicts to main. Denies TaskUpdate(status=completed) when agent_type is present (subagent). Exit 2 + stderr; fail-safe allow on parse error.
Marks the session jira-acli-engaged when a jira-acli:* skill loads, so the companion gate:mcp:atlassian-cold-start gate can allow-list it. Never blocks Skill itself.

Gate: block a direct Atlassian/Jira/Confluence MCP call before a jira-acli:* skill loaded this session — forces routing through jira-acli's templates instead of a cold MCP call. Escape: MH_ALLOW_DIRECT_ATLASSIAN_MCP=1.

Gate: redirect Edit/Write on a guarded sub-repo main checkout or protected branch into a session worktree under ~/.worktrees. Opt-in and off by default: no-op everywhere unless MH_GUARDED_WORKSPACE is set.

Gate: deny (not redirect) a Bash-mediated write that targets a guarded sub-repo main checkout or protected branch. Denies instead of redirecting: a raw shell command's target can't be rewritten via updatedInput the way file_path can. Opt-in and off by default.
